page: Amazon Web Services r9g.2xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. Built on the arm64 architecture, this instance features 8 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz, with one thread per core. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core.

The r9g.2xlarge operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, which offloads virtualization functions to dedicated hardware to maximize resource availability for the guest operating system. The instance does not include local NVMe storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture of the Graviton processor provides a high density of memory resources relative to compute cores, offering a favorable qualitative profile for memory-bound workloads compared to traditional x86 alternatives. This hardware configuration is designed for workloads requiring significant memory capacity without proportional compute scaling, such as in-memory databases, caching layers, and data analytics pipelines.
